item.title: Patch now (update): SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN: Use of Single-factor Authentication
item.description:
SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN: exploited from day 0 · fix: 7.3.4-7015, 8.2.2-8015 · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Update SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN to 7.3.4-7015 or 8.2.2-8015 or later.

SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN contains a use of single-factor authentication vulnerability that may allow a user with valid credentials for an alternate authentication method to bypass SAML authentication controls. Successful exploitation may also bypass SAML-enforced multi-factor authentication (MFA).

High · Fix available · CVE-2026-19868
